tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: Est-ce que tu montres tes photos à ta grand-mère ?
tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: Oui, je lui montre mes photos.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Est-ce que vous parlez à vos voisins ?”

B hears the question and builds the answer with an indirect object pronoun. A tile like “lui / leur” means: choose! lui replaces à + one person (à ta mère → lui), leur replaces à + several people (à tes parents → leur). A tile like “me / te” or “nous / vous” works the same way: who is the speaker, who is spoken to?

The pronoun goes before the verb (je lui montre). In the passé composé it goes before avoir (je lui ai répondu). With “ne … pas” the pair goes around the pronoun and the verb (je ne lui ai pas parlé). Before a vowel me and te become m' and t' (il m'écrit). Then B asks question 2 and A answers. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.
